auditor_value: μ_min = 1/(2 tan 60°) = 1/(2√3) = √3/6 ≈ 0.29 (independent of the ladder's mass, length and g)
notes: Torque about the foot gives N_wall = W/(2 tan θ); friction must equal N_wall and the ground normal equals W, so μ ≥ 1/(2 tan θ). Both common-mistake values (1/tan 60° and 1/(2 sin 60°), each 0.58) follow from their stated causes.
